title: About the streak feature
body:
This is one of my favorite apps to date, however I’ve felt a lot less satisfied with it ever since the streak feature was added.

With the streak, it makes me feel forced to open the finch app every day and that I’ve failed as a person if I miss a day. This is just my brain however but a few friends of mine have also said that the streak bugs them. I also understand that the streak may help people, which is why I think that there should at least be a feature to remove the streak if it bothers you.

Again, this is a great app but the streak is an inconvenience.
